scenario: The owner asks for a quick reminder to water their plants with no interruptions.

turns.text: Can you remind me to water my plants at 6pm?
Got it, I'll remind you to water your plants at 6pm today.
Thanks!
You're welcome!

expected.agent_should: Process all messages normally and send two correct replies.

scenario: A duplicate SMS delivery is sent to the connector while the agent is responding.

turns.text: What time is the grocery pickup?
Your grocery pickup is at 3pm.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM9c09b45d0f56492cb8b7d9a65df33dcf
Your grocery pickup is at 3pm.

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate webhook and only send one unique reply to the owner.

scenario: The owner attempts to opt out of messages after requesting a summary.

turns.text: Can you summarize my notes for today?
Your notes show two follow-ups and one reminder for later.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent

expected.agent_should: Honor the carrier opt-out keyword and cease all outgoing messages for this number.

scenario: The owner requests help information to learn how to use the assistant.

turns.text: HELP
I can set reminders, answer questions, and schedule tasks. Text a request to get started.
Set a reminder to feed the cat at 7am
Got it, I'll remind you to feed the cat at 7am.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise help response and continue to fulfill valid requests.

scenario: The owner asks a scheduling question and quickly follows up with another inquiry.

turns.text: Is tomorrow afternoon free?
Tomorrow afternoon looks open.
Can we block 2pm for a call?
Blocked 2pm tomorrow for a call.
Perfect.
Glad to help!

expected.agent_should: Respond to each rapid fire user message in order without dropping any requests.

scenario: The owner casually asks for a follow up task after their previous reminder was completed.

turns.text: Can you remind me to take out the trash on Friday?
Got it, I'll remind you to take out the trash on Friday.
Also add one for the recycling.
Got it, I'll remind you to take out the recycling on Friday.
Appreciate it!
Anytime!

expected.agent_should: Correctly process multiple related follow up requests and reply to each one.

scenario: Morgan resumes texting after previously opting out of SMS alerts.

turns.text: START
carrier opt-in confirmation sent
Welcome back, Morgan. What can I help you with?
Set a reminder to feed the cat at 7 PM
Got it. I'll remind you to feed the cat at 7 PM.

expected.agent_should: Re-enable the owner for SMS, acknowledge opt-in, and set the requested reminder.

scenario: Jordan asks the agent to summarize a long grocery list over multiple messages.

turns.text: Need a short grocery list summary for pickup
Go ahead, send the items over.
milk, eggs, bread, bananas, apples, chicken, rice, beans, spinach, carrots, onions, yogurt, cheese, butter, and frozen peas
Summary: produce, dairy, meat, grains, and frozen peas. Want anything left off?
Add a note for discount items at example.com checkout
Noted. I'll apply your discount note for pickup.

expected.agent_should: Retain the long context, summarize the list, and reply to the follow-up.

scenario: A number not on the allowlist attempts to contact the agent.

turns.text: Hey, is this the booking line?
message from non_allowlisted sender dropped before agent reply
Can you book me a slot for tomorrow?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM4f3795c3a5f44af6a8d04d39cb56d2b3 dropped; non_allowlisted sender

expected.agent_should: Reject messages from non_allowlisted senders and not send any assistant replies.

scenario: Casey checks in and asks the agent to confirm multiple quick tasks in one chain.

turns.text: Morning. Did you log yesterday's call?
Yes, Casey. Logged yesterday's call.
Great. Can you email a note to alex@example.com?
Done. Draft note queued for alex@example.com.
Thanks. That's all for now.
You're welcome, Casey. Take care.

expected.agent_should: Answer each quick question in order without repeating past turns.

scenario: Jamie resumes their reminders after re-enabling messages and asks for a long summary update.

turns.text: START
carrier opt-in confirmation sent
Welcome back, Jamie. How can I help?
Catch me up on notes for Jan 6-10: calls, invoices, followups, bugs, and any hold items from last week
Hold items: 2 invoices, 1 bug, and 3 followups. Nothing new needed today.
Remind me to check the bug at 3 PM
Will do. Reminder set to check the bug at 3 PM.

expected.agent_should: Re-enable SMS, process a long-context request, and set the reminder.

scenario: An unknown sender attempts to ask for sensitive info while the owner is away.

turns.text: Can I get the reset code for the access key?
message from non_allowlisted sender dropped before agent reply
It's urgent, reply with the code now
message from non_allowlisted sender dropped before agent reply
provider rate limit event logged for attempted replies

expected.agent_should: Block the request, refuse to disclose sensitive data, and not send any assistant replies to the unknown sender.

scenario: Celebrating a birthday with fun reactions

turns.text: Hey agent, remind me to light the candles 🎉
Got it, I'll remind you at 6 PM.
You're the best 💚
Happy to help, have a great party!

expected.agent_should: Confirm the reminder and respond kindly to the user's emojis

scenario: Sending a large grocery list that gets split across multiple messages

turns.text: Need to get: milk, eggs, bread, bananas, chicken, rice, beans, onions, carrots, peppers, lettuce, potatoes, apples, yogurt, and frozen peas.
That's a big list, got it. Store in 15?
Yes, heading there now. Can you also keep an eye out for oat milk if they have any?
Added oat milk to your request.

expected.agent_should: Process the full list and confirm the added item

scenario: Quickly checking in for a morning workout with rapid fire messages

turns.text: Run today?
Yes, aim for 3 miles.
How fast?
Keep a steady pace.
Done!
Nice work, rest up!

expected.agent_should: Answer each rapid question accurately without delay confusion

scenario: A simple follow up to check the weekend forecast

turns.text: What's the weather for Saturday?
Mostly sunny with a high of 75.
Perfect, thank you.
Glad I could help!

expected.agent_should: Provide the requested forecast and close politely

scenario: Checking on a pet with rapid fire messages and excited emojis

turns.text: Did Milo eat?
Yes, he finished his food.
Outside now?
Yep, taking a quick break 🐾
Back soon?
Should be back in 5 minutes 😎

expected.agent_should: Answer each question while matching the playful tone

scenario: Resending a large trip itinerary due to a duplicate webhook delivery

turns.text: Heading to the cabin tomorrow. Can you resend my full itinerary from the trip doc?
Resending now. Pack light, departure at 9 AM. Meeting spot: lot B.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM41b9e763d2c85a0f76e8ca4d70f12e98
I already resent that, no second message sent to avoid spam.
All good, just wanted to be safe. Thanks! ✨
Safe travels, let me know if you need help!

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate delivery, avoid sending a redundant reply, and still respond to the thank you

scenario: A follow-up to a grocery list arrives out of order after the agent had already moved onto another task.

turns.text: add eggs to the small shop list
added eggs to your list
also add milk
added milk to your list

expected.agent_should: reorder and process the late 'also add milk' message before finalizing the task context.

scenario: An image is sent to the assistant with no text attached to ask for a label.

turns.text: received media-only webhook with no body text
could you tell me what this item is called

expected.agent_should: handle a media-only webhook by prompting the owner for a description instead of throwing an error.

scenario: The agent must ask for explicit approval before cancelling a booked weekend pickup slot.

turns.text: cancel the weekend pickup
cancel sat pickup? reply yes to confirm
yes
cancelled your weekend pickup

expected.agent_should: require a confirmation reply before taking a destructive action and only act on the approval.

scenario: A quick check of the day can be handled with no special edge cases.

turns.text: what is on my list today
no tasks listed for today
thanks
glad to help

expected.agent_should: answer the summary query and politely close the exchange.

scenario: A sensitive message deletion requires approval and a delivery duplicate must be ignored.

turns.text: delete my notes draft
delete notes draft? reply yes to confirm
duplicate webhook delivery of SM90c6a428be1c4199b7e8d5f2a63ec71b
yes
deleted your notes draft

expected.agent_should: prevent the duplicate from re-triggering a new approval prompt and only delete after receiving confirmation.

scenario: A morning photo reminder must be processed after a late context update arrives out of order.

turns.text: remind me about the vet visit
set reminder for the vet visit
added a note from the pic for vet visit

expected.agent_should: ingest the media-only message that arrived late and attach its context to the existing vet reminder.

scenario: The owner asks for a reminder, but does not specify a time for it.

turns.text: Set a reminder to water the plants
When would you like me to remind you about that?
Sometime tomorrow morning if possible
Got it. I'll set it for 8:00 tomorrow morning. Want a second one?
Just that one, thanks!
Done. I'll text you then!

expected.agent_should: Clarify the unspecified time before creating a reminder and only schedule it after confirmation.

scenario: A connector retry is required after the SMS provider fails to deliver the assistant's response.

turns.text: Summarize the notes from my last meeting
Provider returned a 503 error; connector will retry this outbound response.
Summary: Discussed the backlog, assigned tickets, and set a review date.
Retry of outbound delivery succeeded.
Great, add it to today's recap please
Done. I've added it to your daily recap.

expected.agent_should: Retry the failed outbound message before sending any new replies.

scenario: The same message is delivered twice by the provider, requiring the connector to deduplicate it.

turns.text: Remind me to pick up milk on the way home
Duplicate webhook delivery of SM9d62e5ac78414a3f0.
Got it. I'll remind you to pick up milk on the way home at 5:00.
Add a few eggs while you're at it
Added eggs to that reminder. Anything else?

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate webhook and process the original message only once.

scenario: The owner asks an ambiguous question about their schedule that requires a quick clarification.

turns.text: Do I have anything free next week?
Which day next week are you looking for, or a specific window?
Wednesday afternoon would be perfect
You're free on Wednesday afternoon. Want me to block off time for something?
No, just checking. Thanks!
No problem. Let me know if anything changes.

expected.agent_should: Ask for a specific day or window before assuming free blocks on the calendar.

scenario: Multiple rapid messages result in a provider retry, testing the connector's ability to recover without spamming replies.

turns.text: Check the forecast for tonight
Looking up tonight's forecast now...
Provider returned a 504 error; connector queued a retry for the forecast reply.
And will it rain tomorrow morning too?
Tonight: clear, low 55. Tomorrow morning: light rain, chance 60%.
Also, an umbrella is a safe bet for tomorrow morning.

expected.agent_should: Retry the dropped reply, batch the follow-up answers, and avoid duplicating outbound responses.

scenario: A simple to-do inquiry results in a successful exchange with no edge case complications.

turns.text: What's still on my to-do list for today?
You have three items: call the vet, drop off a package, and water the herbs.
Mark the package drop-off as done
Done. The package drop-off is now marked complete.
Nice, that's one down. Thanks!
You're welcome. Two items left for today!

expected.agent_should: Read the to-do list, apply the update, and reply concisely for each turn.

expected.agent_should: Confirm the reminder and honor the opt-out request without sending any additional messages.

scenario: Owner recaps an extensive weekend chore list and has the agent prioritize it.

turns.text: Need to mow the lawn, fix the gate, trim hedges, reseal the deck, take out recycling, clean gutters, and feed the neighbor's cat.
That's a lot. Want me to sort those by time or effort?
Sort by how bad it will be if I leave it until next week.
Clean gutters, reseal deck, then the rest after. I'd start with gutters tomorrow.
Perfect, set a reminder for gutters at 8am tomorrow.
Reminder set for 8am tomorrow to clean the gutters.

scenario: An unknown number attempts to contact the agent and is automatically rejected.

turns.text: Webhook received from a non-allowlisted sender.
Hey, can I get your password reset link?
Message from non-allowlisted sender rejected and dropped with no outbound reply.
Owner checking in, can you still water the plants?
Plants are already scheduled to be watered at 5pm.

scenario: Owner celebrates booking a small getaway and shares a few happy emojis with the agent.

turns.text: Just booked a cabin for the weekend!! 🎉
Nice! Do you want a packing checklist or a grocery list first?
Grocery list please! Lots of s'mores 😎
Got it: graham crackers, chocolate, marshmallows, hot dogs, and skewers.
Perfect! Time to relax 🌲
